item.text: I found a good target: `SQLQueryLexicalScope` repeats interval extraction and position checks in its lookup methods, which makes the precedence rules harder to reason about. I’m reading that class now and will consolidate the shared logic, then add tests around the lookup behavior.

I’m making a small cleanup in `SQLQueryLexicalScope`: switch the interval computation to straightforward loops and factor the repeated position checks into named helpers. I’ll back it with a unit test that exercises both `findItem` and `findNearestItem` so the selection rules stay explicit.
The cleanup is applied. I’m doing a quick validation pass now for formatting and obvious compile hazards, then I’ll summarize exactly what changed and any caveats.
I’m collecting line references for the summary. This pass is done from a source perspective; I just need exact locations for the cleanup and the new coverage.

Refactored `SQLQueryLexicalScope` to remove repeated interval/position logic and added tests for the lookup rules.

- `getInterval()` now uses straightforward loops instead of two `Stream.concat(...)` chains, which makes the cache computation easier to read and keeps the empty-scope fallback explicit: [SQLQueryLexicalScope.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.sql/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/semantics/SQLQueryLexicalScope.java#L69)
- `findItem()` and `findNearestItem()` now share named helpers for the position checks, so the containment semantics are visible in one place: [SQLQueryLexicalScope.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.sql/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/semantics/SQLQueryLexicalScope.java#L126), [SQLQueryLexicalScope.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.sql/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/semantics/SQLQueryLexicalScope.java#L150)
- Added regression coverage for:
  - interval aggregation across registered items and syntax nodes
  - `findItem()` returning the containing item with the smallest start offset
  - `findNearestItem()` preferring the tightest matching item: [SQLQueryLexicalScopeTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/test/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.sql.test/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/semantics/SQLQueryLexicalScopeTest.java#L32)
